crossRefs.note: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
He said: “Yahweh will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn…
One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has…
“But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’
Amaziah also said to Amos, “You seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
If I say, I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning…
for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
“Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”
But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t…

translations.web: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord Yahweh has spoken. Who can but prophesy?
translations.bsb: The lion has roared— who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken— who will not prophesy?
translations.kjv: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
translations.asv: The lion hath roared; who will not fear? The Lord Jehovah hath spoken; who can but prophesy?
